subject: Upcoming Travel Itinerary Details
body: Dear [Recipient], I hope this email finds you well. I wanted to share the final details of our upcoming trip to Paris. Our flight is scheduled for 9:00 AM on June 15th from JFK Airport, and we will be staying at the Le Meridien Etoile Hotel. The itinerary includes visits to the Louvre Museum, Eiffel Tower, and Montmartre. Please let me know if you have any questions or need further information. I look forward to exploring Paris with you! Best regards, [Your Name]
